summary: The web voice dock now matches Flutter's connection-quality indicator. It reads local LiveKit quality and remote-inbound audio RTT, refreshes only for an active voice session, and clears/stops polling during reconnect and leave. Local UI, normalization, suite, and production-build checks pass; a live peer has not been used to validate platform reports.

checks.name: Normalize quality and read actual audio RTT reports
checks.observation: Covers all quality categories, accepts only remote-inbound-rtp RTT, converts seconds to milliseconds, and preserves unavailable or out-of-range RTT as null.

checks.name: Web dock presentation and accessibility label
checks.observation: SSR assertions verify visible ping, quality class and label, and an explicit unavailable placeholder instead of fabricated zero latency.

checks.name: Connection polling lifecycle
checks.observation: Verifies immediate and two-second sampling, cleanup on dispose, suppression of late async updates after reconnect/leave, and contained stats read failures.

checks.name: Frontend test suite
checks.observation: All 665 tests in 223 files passed. Existing Vue prop warnings remain in unrelated test fixtures.

checks.name: Production frontend build
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build passed; Vite reports its existing large LiveKit chunk advisory.

remaining: Join a real voice room with a peer and verify quality transitions and RTT availability in current browsers; compare visual placement against the Flutter dock at compact and desktop widths.
